report:
## Verdict

**READY_NAVIGATION_PUBLICATION_ONLY.** The top finding is that the exact 7-file Luna/Graphify R2 fragment is correct for navigation-only publication: the pinned base (1489 nodes / 3756 ordered links, SHA 248949c5…) is preserved as an exact prefix to 1508/3782 (+19 nodes / +26 ordered links), only one `fragment_updates` entry is appended, original metadata is unchanged, and all 45 new node/edge citations resolve and are faithful to the actual cited sources. Source readiness is NAV only.

## Evidence

Base preservation is asserted identically in [GRAPH_REPORT.md](/home/charl/moriarty-eutxo-validation-2026-10-12/current-cardano-preprod-observation-and-binding-luna-graph-fragment-r2-20261016/GRAPH_REPORT.md:3), [READ-COVERAGE.json](/home/charl/moriarty-eutxo-validation-2026-10-12/current-cardano-preprod-observation-and-binding-luna-graph-fragment-r2-20261016/READ-COVERAGE.json:36) and the appended entry in [graph.json](/home/charl/moriarty-eutxo-validation-2026-10-12/current-cardano-preprod-observation-and-binding-luna-graph-fragment-r2-20261016/graphify-out/graph.json:85743), and independently recorded by the R2 root checker at [GRAPH-AND-POINTER-CHECK.json](/home/charl/moriarty-eutxo-validation-2026-10-12/current-cardano-preprod-observation-and-binding-graph-r2-root-records-20261016/GRAPH-AND-POINTER-CHECK.json:8) (`prefixPayloadsEqual=true`, `newCitationsResolved=45`, `noDanglingLinks=true`, `sourceMetadataAllUsedFlagsMatched=true`). The R1 checker's single failure — the Graphify receipt declared `used=true` while actually unused — is repaired in R2 with no graph change, correctly not blamed on Luna: compare [R1 check](/home/charl/moriarty-eutxo-validation-2026-10-12/current-cardano-preprod-observation-and-binding-graph-root-records-20261016/GRAPH-AND-POINTER-CHECK.json:419) with [SOURCE-MANIFEST.json](/home/charl/moriarty-eutxo-validation-2026-10-12/current-cardano-preprod-observation-and-binding-luna-graph-fragment-r2-20261016/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json:205).

Navigation facts are faithfully qualified. The 14:50 UTC five-call observation, its adoption (60a7cbeb, 119 files) and the pending source-time `PUBLICATION.json` preserved beside the actual `root/PUBLICATION-COMPLETED.json` match [README.md](/home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/utxo/evidence/utxo/cardano-preprod-public-observation-2026-10-16/README.md:3) and the adoption record. `[]` with `Content-Range: */*` is never upgraded to zero/unfunded/current absence; the same-provider stable tip is not atomic or authenticated; cost-model ordering/units, EraHistory, fee/min-ADA/ExUnits and size-fit stay unqualified. The Preview faucet result (tx 9ea68a9b…, output 0 unspent, raw value `10000000000`, exact wallet, no Preprod seed, no ADA conversion) matches [RESULT.json](/home/charl/moriarty-eutxo-validation-2026-10-12/cardano-preprod-wallet-funding-9ea68a9b-followup-public-20261016/RESULT.json:114). The FX1 R2 tally is DesignAdoption-only: 12 literal author-FOR + reviewer-AGREE via one full Gemini review and a focused correction, not two full audits, with the full review's wrong wallet/CBOR/signing-data/digests/paraphrases preserved as excluded history ([DESIGN-POSITION-TALLY.json](/home/charl/moriarty-eutxo-validation-2026-10-12/current-cardano-fx1-real-preprod-binding-r2-root-adoption-20261016/DESIGN-POSITION-TALLY.json:3), [REVIEW-QUALIFICATIONS.json](/home/charl/moriarty-eutxo-validation-2026-10-12/current-cardano-fx1-real-preprod-binding-r2-root-qualifications-20261016/REVIEW-QUALIFICATIONS.json:99)). T1 thread outref vs wallet seed, atomic T3 (thread+claim spend, Burn −1, all five VI/VS withdraw-zero plus S2p, no T4 success burn), canonical-JSON (not CBOR) intent payload, and still-owed genuine VI/fresh-context proof/actual Preprod are all preserved.

## Limitations and first blocked boundary

Five citations use whole-document `#` or `#/files` locations; they resolve but are document-level, not field-level, evidence — a publication note, not a graph defect. Luna did not open the five raw response bodies (pins only), and this review did not either. Graphify 0.9.91 is 'latest' only at the 13:32 receipt; token accounting is unknown and the HTML retains its CDN dependency. No security interpretation is drawn. The first blocked boundary remains Preprod funding/real thread context, then genuine intent, fresh-context proof, atomic T3 and actual signed Preprod acceptance. All 20 UTxO families, ACTUS/DeFi/general obligations, recursion, private handoff, bounded multi-parent PCD, universal certificates and real Preprod remain open; no compatibility percentage is stated.

## Independence
